mapper.select: SELECT broker_id, broker_code, broker_name, is_active FROM broker_providers WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY broker_id
SELECT broker_id, broker_code, broker_name, is_active FROM broker_providers WHERE broker_id = #{brokerId}
SELECT broker_id, broker_code, broker_name, is_active FROM broker_providers WHERE broker_code = #{brokerCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO broker_providers (broker_code, broker_name, is_active) VALUES (#{brokerCode}, #{brokerName}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE broker_providers SET broker_name = #{brokerName}, is_active = TRUE WHERE broker_code = #{brokerCode}
